blocking_findings.location: commit subject: 'chore: add gate-plan.json artifact for EPMCDME-8534'
blocking_findings.violation: git-workflow.md requires the format EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence (regex: ^(EPMCDME)-(?!0+)\d+:\s[A-Z][a-z]*.*$); this subject uses a conventional-commits 'chore:' prefix with no ticket number
blocking_findings.why_blocking: Tekton CI blocks the pipeline on any commit subject that does not match the documented regex
blocking_findings.remedy: Amend the subject to 'EPMCDME-8534: Add gate-plan.json artifact for review round'
